titles: every variant's compiled stylesheet, the kit's layout included, is inside its manifest's css budget
every bundled variant and pack declares budgets within its ceilings
the first sentence: never after an abbreviation or an initial, nor inside a link or code
the poster cell and the practice cell stand side by side, ruled in the ink, under the tape
every core kind renders bespoke, and the manifest says so
the opening and the close: subtitles under their tapes, the CTA subtitle, the email, a custom caption
every case page passes the outline check: one h1, the title; every part at its anchor; nothing shared
